title: EKU check against certificate type
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 11. Verifying: the same steps upwards; HCERT Specification, A.2 Extended Key Usage Identifiers.

statements.label: EKU check against certificate type
statements.requirement: If the matching DSC has an Extended Key Usage extension with any of 1.3.6.1.4.1.1847.2021.1.1 (test), .1.2 (vaccinations) or .1.3 (recovery), the verifier SHALL check it against the certificate type of the payload, using a pluggable CertificateTypeResolver. A DSC with no such extension SHALL be accepted for any type. The default resolver SHALL map DVC (-6) and DDCC VS (3) to vaccinations and DDCC TR (4) to test.

sources.quote: If one or more are present, the verifiers SHALL verify the key usage against the stored HCERT.
